query_analysis.original_query: Calculate the theoretical minimum energy required to separate a binary gas-liquid mixture under isothermal conditions. The feed stream contains 60 mol% Component A and 40 mol% Component B, entering at a pressure of 5 bar and a temperature of 298 K. The desired products are a gas stream with 95 mol% Component A and a liquid stream with 90 mol% Component B. Assume ideal gas and liquid behavior, and neglect heat losses or inefficiencies in the separation process.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Determine the thermodynamic minimum work required for separating a binary gas-liquid mixture with specified initial and final composition using theoretical separation principles

communication_strategy.information_flow: Detailed thermodynamic work calculation and verification

clarification_questions: Are the components of the binary mixture specified?
What are the physical properties of Components A and B?
Do you require a specific calculation method for the minimum energy (e.g., Gibbs free energy approach)?
